metadata.title: Furnova — Accounting Built for Furniture Businesses
metadata.description: Complete double-entry accounting for furniture retail: contacts, products, chart of accounts, purchase orders, sales invoices, payments and real-time financial reports — one connected ledger.
metadata.ogTitle: Furnova — Every entry balanced, every report real-time
metadata.ogDescription: Master data, transactions, automatic journal entries and financial reports. Built for real furniture businesses and real margins.

hero.description: Record purchases, sales and payments once — Furnova generates the double-entry journal behind every transaction and keeps your Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss and Budget Report accurate in real time.

agents.intro: Master data, transactions and reporting are not separate tools. Every module writes into the same double-entry ledger, so a sale recorded once appears correctly everywhere it should.

features.intro: From master data to financial statements — Furnova enforces accounting rules at the database level, so the numbers you report are the numbers you can defend.

multiAgent.title: Automatic Double-Entry
multiAgent.description: Confirm a vendor bill or post a customer invoice and the matching journal entry is generated for you — debits and credits balanced, tax posted to its own account, never lumped into income.

edgeAnalytics.title: Real-Time Financial Reports
edgeAnalytics.description: Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss and Budget Report are computed live from posted entries. No overnight batch, no stale figures — select a period and read the current position.

satelliteFusion.title: Organization-Level Isolation
satelliteFusion.description: Every record belongs to exactly one organization. Contacts, products, ledgers and reports are scoped so no business can ever see another's books.

adaptiveLoop.title: Budget vs Actual Tracking
adaptiveLoop.description: Tag transactions to an analytic account for a project, store or department, and the Budget Report compares planned against actual spend with live variance.

howItWorks.intro: Four steps take a real business event all the way through to an auditable financial statement — with no manual journal work in between.

ingestion.title: Set Up Master Data
ingestion.description: Add contacts (customers and vendors), products with prices and tax, your chart of accounts, journals and analytic accounts. Enter each fact once.

analysis.title: Record Transactions
analysis.description: Raise a purchase order, convert it to a vendor bill, create a sales order and generate the customer invoice — all built from your master data.

fusion.title: Auto Journal Entries
fusion.description: Every confirmed bill, invoice and payment posts a balanced journal entry: debtors, creditors, income, expense and tax each land in the right account.

action.title: Generate Reports
action.description: Select a period and read the Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss and Budget Report — computed directly from the posted ledger, ready to review or export.

tech.intro: PostgreSQL-backed transactional integrity, a modular Node.js API and a fast Next.js interface — the stack an accounting system needs when every write has to be exact.

chipScene.intro: Furnova's accounting engine — sixteen connected modules on a single transactional substrate, posting balanced entries the moment a document is confirmed.

cta.intro: Create your organization, invite your accountant, and record your first invoice today. Your chart of accounts and journals are set up for you automatically.
